title: Did a Pandya Prince Kill His Own Father? | Madurai, 1310 #shorts

lines.text: Did a Pandya prince kill his own father?
Madurai, around thirteen ten. King Kulasekhara had ruled about forty years.
Two Persian chroniclers say he favoured Vira, a son they call illegitimate, over Sundara.

lines.text: In their story, Sundara struck down his father and took Madurai.

lines.text: Vira fought back. Brother against brother, the kingdom split in two.

lines.text: In thirteen eleven, Malik Kafur's army marched south.
